3:30.text: On the Day when every person will be confronted with all the good he has done, and all the evil he has done, he will wish that there were a great distance between him and his evil. And Allâh warns you against Himself
and Allâh is full of kindness to

3:31.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to mankind)
(i.e. accept Islâmic Monotheism, follow the Qur’ân and the Sunnah)
, Allâh will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."

3:32.text: ." But if they turn away, then Allâh does not like the disbelievers

3:33.text: and the family of ‘Imrân above the ‘Âlamîn

3:34.text: Offspring, one of the other, and Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

3:35.text: when the wife of ‘Imrân said: "O my Lord! I have vowed to You what
is in my womb to be dedicated for Your services
(free from all worldly work; to serve Your Place of worship)
, so accept this from me. Verily, You are the All-Hearer, the All-Knowing."

3:36.text: Then when she gave birth to her
, she said: "O my Lord! I have given birth to a female child," - and Allâh knew better what she brought forth, - "And the male is not like the female, and I have named her Maryam
, and I seek refuge with You
for her and for her offspring from Shaitân

3:37.text: accepted her with goodly acceptance. He made her grow in a good manner and put her under the care of Zakariyâ
her, he found her supplied with sustenance. He said: "O Maryam
! From where have you got this?" She said, "This is from Allâh." Verily, Allâh provides sustenance to whom He wills, without limit."
